name: Zoom
summary: Video meetings. This entry applies equally to Google Meet, Teams meetings and Webex: the considerations for leaving are the same.

factors: Everyone already has it and knows where the mute button is
Recurring meeting links embedded in calendars

export.summary: There is almost nothing to migrate. Download the recordings you want to keep and replace your recurring meeting links.

methods.name: Download cloud recordings
methods.detail: Recordings download as ordinary video and audio files from the web portal. Do this before the subscription ends.

methods.name: Replace recurring meetings
methods.detail: List the standing meetings you host and send updated invitations with the new links.

caveats: Cloud recordings are deleted after the subscription lapses or the retention period ends
Webinar registration lists and reports are separate CSV downloads
External guests may be on locked-down networks; test the new tool with a customer before relying on it

paths.verdict: The straightforward replacement for everyday meetings of up to a few dozen people.

import.summary: Nothing to import. Choose an instance (the public one, a hosted service or your own) and start sending links.

transfers: Your meeting habits: links, screen sharing, chat, reactions
Downloaded recordings, as plain video files
lost: Polish and stability in very large meetings
Webinar features such as registration and practice sessions

paths.verdict: Better than Zoom for teaching and workshops; more than you need for ordinary calls.

import.summary: Nothing to import. Create rooms in Greenlight or your learning platform and share the links.

transfers: Classes, workshops and webinars, with whiteboard, polls and breakout rooms
Downloaded recordings, as plain video files
lost: Quick ad-hoc calls: rooms are created in advance

paths.verdict: A good fit for lectures, seminars and small meetings on a server you run yourself; less so for large interactive calls.

import.summary: Nothing to import. Install the server, create a group for each standing meeting and send invitation links.

transfers: Your meeting habits: links, screen sharing, chat, raised hands
Recording, kept on your own server
Downloaded recordings, as plain video files
lost: An iOS app, and screen sharing from phones
